segments.name: Dealerships
segments.description: Buys, sells and wholesales new and pre-owned yachts and boats, also arranging financing, warranties and storage.
segments.evidence: The Dealership segment engages in the sale of new and pre-owned boats, arranges financing and insurance products, provides warranty sales, and offers slip and storage accommodations in certain locations.

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.description: Recreational loan broker and lender providing financing to individuals, dealerships and brokerages.
segments.evidence: The financing service segment engages in providing financing products to individuals for marine, aviation and recreational vehicle purchases.

revenueModel.text: Boat buyers and dealers pay for pre-owned vessels, and individual borrowers and industry partners use its financing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Azure Funding's customers are primarily individual buyers seeking financing for new or pre-owned recreational assets.
